newsitem.title: USA: H.J. Heinz says recruits Campbell exec.
newsitem.headline: H.J. Heinz says recruits Campbell exec.

text.p: H. J. Heinz Co said Tuesday it hired Campbell Soup Co senior executive Daniel O'Neill as executive vice president of Heinz's pet food and tuna units and Heinz's Latin American affiliates.
O'Neill, who joined Campbell in 1994, is president of Campbell's U.S. Soup division and president of Campbell Sales Co, Heinz said.
Campbell will fight O'Neill's move to Heinz because the action violates a no-compete agreement that O'Neill signed when he joined Campbell, said Campbell spokesman Kevin Lowery.
Lowery said O'Neill resigned from Campbell in mid-December.

"We're going to take the appropriate steps to protect our brands and enforce the no-compete agreement that Mr. O'Neill willingly signed," Lowery said. "Taking a top spot at Heinz is clearly a violation of the no-compete agreement."
